Resource exhaustion in jsoup's XmlTreeBuilder when parsing deeply nested XML with many uniquely-namespaced elements. Fixed upstream in commit 862ba2f, but that fix has not shipped in a jsoup release yet - 1.23.2 is the latest available on Maven Central and is still affected. Re-evaluate once a release containing the fix is published.

CVE-2026-93753 / GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4 (CVSS 8.7) in deepmerge 4.3.1: prototype poisoning of the objects mergeObject() returns. Pulled in transitively by the website build (@svgr/plugin-svgo, ^4.3.1). No upstream fix exists as of 2026-10-28 (checked via OSV.dev and GitHub Advisories): 4.3.1 (2023-03-16) is still the latest deepmerge release and GitHub lists it as affected with no patched version; the proposed fix (TehShrike/deepmerge#281) was closed unmerged. Suppression expires 2026-11-04 - re-evaluate then.

False positives for minimatch 3.1.5, pulled in by the website build (serve-handler pins it exactly; 3.1.5 is the newest 3.x release). CVE-2026-27904 / GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74, extglob ReDoS: GitHub and OSV.dev list 3.1.4 as the fix on the 3.x line, so 3.1.5 is not affected. CVE-2026-118764 / GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, globParts amplification in firstPhasePreProcess() when optimizationLevel >= 2: OSV.dev lists every version below 11.0.1, but minimatch 3.1.5 has neither firstPhasePreProcess nor optimizationLevel (checked in the published 3.1.5 package, 2026-11-02). Pinned to 3.1.5, so it stops applying if the website moves off it.
